## Operating boundary

Preserve Tested / UI observed / Source observed / Vendor described / Unverified labels. A route in the source-discovered catalog is not a vendor contract. Verify identity, scope, quotas and delivery readiness before acting. Do not claim that this hosting publication places these sources automatically into ChatGPT project context. Raw account evidence and the supplied transcript are held in the owner's private here.now Drive.
